C23 and C11 share greeting/conveyance and peace-and-security language, respectively, but lack C13's close combination of an international scientific gathering and information exchange.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"As NATO's Advisory Group for Aeronautical Research and Development meets in Washington today ... convey my warm welcome to all who are participating.","parent_excerpt":"extend the welcome of this Government to the Congress and to the scientists attending its proceedings","explanation":"Both extend a presidential welcome to participants attending a scientific meeting."},{"child_excerpt":"In conducting joint discussion and scientific exchange in aeronautical research and development","parent_excerpt":"will encourage the free exchange of scientific information among the metallurgists of the world","explanation":"The distinctive scientific-exchange formulation is closely parallel and adapted to a different technical field."},{"child_excerpt":"it serves as a model for others in practical and productive cooperation","parent_excerpt":"I request that all Federal departments and agencies assist and cooperate with the Second World Metallurgical Congress","explanation":"Both frame the scientific gathering as an occasion for productive institutional cooperation, though the child's statement is more evaluative than operative."}]}
